title: I Thought I Knew WordPress Theme Development Until My First Project
why_read: A beginner-level personal reflection on learning WordPress theme development, useful mainly to newcomers rather than experienced engineers.
analysis: This post walks through the author's realization that WordPress theme development involves much more structural complexity (template hierarchy, hooks, classic versus block themes) than simply writing HTML/CSS/PHP. It's a fairly basic, introductory-level discussion aimed at developers new to WordPress rather than offering deep technical insight for experienced engineers. The content is accurate but covers well-trodden ground that any WordPress documentation or tutorial already explains.
